x: We made a grand start by having both our men in the final of the 100 yards, and " Ginger " Holtum surprised many by beating Clay Gibbs to win in 10.5 seconds.
Basil Walden won the 100 yds., beating Gibbs, of Herne Hill, and the latter was also beaten by Alan Sexton in the 220. Jack Brown and Ian Badiali were 2nd and 3rd in the 880, and A.

Ryan and Hennings again took first two places in the Junior 220 yds. but C.Jones had to be content with 2nd place to Gibbs of Herne Hill, Whilst Morris, who is now a recruit at the Police Training School scored 4th place for the police.

Next came Gerry North and with a time beaten only by Dick Taylor of Coventry, Tim Johnston of Portsmouth and Gibbs of Birchfield took us into 10th place but still the same distance behind the leaders.
